description: This PHP source file defines the ConnectCampaignServiceClient class used to interact with the AmazonConnectCampaignService API. It includes method annotations for various campaign and resource management operations, indicating the client’s capabilities in managing campaigns, configurations, and tags within the service.

classes.name: ConnectCampaignServiceClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, specifically generated to handle the AmazonConnectCampaignService API operations.

methods.name: createCampaign
methods.description: Creates a new campaign within the Amazon Connect Campaign Service.

methods.name: deleteCampaign
methods.description: Deletes an existing campaign.

methods.name: deleteConnectInstanceConfig
methods.description: Deletes the connect instance configuration.

methods.name: deleteInstanceOnboardingJob
methods.description: Deletes the onboarding job for the instance.

methods.name: describeCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific campaign.

methods.name: getCampaignState
methods.description: Fetches the current state of a specified campaign.

methods.name: getCampaignStateBatch
methods.description: Retrieves states for multiple campaigns in batch.

methods.name: getConnectInstanceConfig
methods.description: Gets the configuration of the connect instance.

methods.name: getInstanceOnboardingJobStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of the onboarding job for the instance.

methods.name: listCampaigns
methods.description: Lists all campaigns.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: pauseCampaign
methods.description: Pauses an active campaign.

methods.name: putDialRequestBatch
methods.description: Pushes a batch of dial requests.

methods.name: resumeCampaign
methods.description: Resumes a paused campaign.

methods.name: startCampaign
methods.description: Starts a campaign.

methods.name: startInstanceOnboardingJob
methods.description: Starts the onboarding job for the instance.

methods.name: stopCampaign
methods.description: Stops an active campaign.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource with specified tags.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateCampaignDialerConfig
methods.description: Updates the dialer configuration for a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignName
methods.description: Updates the name of a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignOutboundCallConfig
methods.description: Updates the outbound call configuration for a campaign.
